text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Head of parliament's human rights committee Ghannam al- Jamhour might resign due to lack of Interior Ministry cooperation.
- Kuwaiti businessmen team to visit Singapore next week to view commercial and industrial activities.
- Iraq invites Iran and Syria to form an anti-Turkey front.

- Gulf Arab foreign ministers call on Iraq to release Kuwaiti prisoners of war, pay compensations for damages and return stolen property. Kuwait accuses Baghdad of detaining some 600 people since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis.
- Gulf Arab foreign ministers call on Turkey to withdraw troops from Iraq. Turkish forces crossed into northern Iraq on May 14 to wipe out Kurdish bases.
- Chairman of Kuwait's higher committee for the implementation of Sharia Islamic law has completed proposed ammendments for more than 500 articles of the penal law.
- Education Ministry seeks better salary scale for social workers.
